title: (Nor): vertical deviation from a rotated graph plane is controlled by the distance to it
statement: For natural numbers n, l, a linear isometry equivalence q of R^(n+l), a continuous linear map A : R^n -> R^l with operator norm ||A|| <= 1, and x in R^n, y in R^l: let Gamma_A = span{graphPoint v (A v) : v in R^n}, K = q(Gamma_A) = Gamma_A.map q, P the orthogonal projection (starProjection) of R^(n+l) onto K, and w = q(graphPoint x y). Then ||y - A x|| <= 2 ||w - P w||.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (x : Rn n) (y : Rn ℓ), ‖A‖ ≤ 1 → ‖y - A x‖ ≤ 2 * ‖q (graphPoint x y) - ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap).starProjection (q (graphPoint x y))‖
